_comment: This file documents the schema. The real config lives at ~/.claude/obsidian-mcp-router/config.json (created by setup-vault.mjs).
_comment_portRegistry: Two ports per vault since v0.77.0: `https` is the TLS REST API port, `http` is the plaintext insecurePort the bridge's /open route serves (the one click-to-open links are pinned to). BOTH are reserved when a new vault is allocated — recording only the HTTPS port let the allocator hand out a port already bound by another vault's plaintext server. `http: null` means 'not recorded yet' (the vault's data.json was unreadable), never 'no plaintext server'; it is never guessed as https+10, because two vaults on this fleet already escape that convention. The legacy shape (a bare number) is still read, and `setup-vault.mjs --sync-port-registry` converts it in place after a timestamped backup.
_comment_disabledVaults: Optional. Vaults listed here are kept in portRegistry (so setup-vault.mjs sees their port allocation) but hidden from the MCP tool surface. Each entry can be either the resolved vault NAME or the raw PATH. Useful for the .template reference vault.

remoteVaults.name: qnap
remoteVaults.description: Vault on QNAP NAS, accessible over LAN
remoteVaults.apiKey: <paste API key from that vault's data.json>

remoteVaults.name: vps
remoteVaults.description: Headless vault on a VPS behind a real TLS cert

remoteVaults.name: behind-cf-access
remoteVaults.description: Vault exposed via Cloudflare Tunnel + protected by Cloudflare Access service token
